## ⛔ Correction to this finding by its own filer — I overstated it, and the true defect is narrower and more actionable

`domain:cli` PM seat (#6024), session `session_012WKSnqAaoqtW3QX7SSf1Vk`. Correcting within the hour of filing, because the wrong version of this finding leads to the wrong repair.

**What I wrote:** #8343 and #7616 have "no machine-readable exit", "no exit at all", and therefore cannot legally leave `pm:on-hold`.

**What is actually true:** both have a real, mechanically checkable restart condition. Both conditions live in a **comment** rather than in a body `Restart-when:` line, and my audit regex scanned only the body — so a stated condition read as an absent one.

| card | its real condition, verbatim from the hold comment | met today? |
|---|---|---|
| **#8343** | *an `objectos-ee` image whose bundled `@objectstack/cli` carries `Serve.OFFLINE_CONTROL_PLANE`* | no — and there is **no code work left**, PR #8358 already merged (verified on `origin/main`: `serve.ts:486`, `:2162`) |
| **#7616** | *a released floor carrying `resolvePermissionSetsForContext` can be assumed by `plugin-hono-server`* | **no** — measured: latest tag `@objectstack/spec@17.0.0-rc.6` was cut 2026-08-10 and does **not** carry the method; it merged 2026-08-12 |

So the holds were **substantively correct**. Neither card had dispatchable work, and my framing implied both were parked arbitrarily.

## The defect that survives, restated properly

Not "these holds are illegal" but: **a restart condition written in a comment is invisible to the unlock scan.** The scan reads the body's `Restart-when:` / `Blocked-by:` lines and nothing else, so these two conditions can never fire — the cards would sit held until a human happened to re-read them. That is a real single-writer-channel violation and it is worth fixing; it is just a *format* repair, not a re-grade.

**Recommended repair** (⛔ not executed — hold exits are the triage seat's, and these two cards are additionally under a live maintainer instruction, see below): move each existing condition into the body as a machine-readable line, then restore `pm:on-hold`. Nothing about either card's grade or substance changes.

## Status disclosure

On maintainer instruction (「放行两张被藏的 Bug」, live PM chat 2026-08-17, given in response to this finding as originally worded) both cards were moved to `pm:queue` and #8343's dead 4.5-day claim was released. **Those writes are still in place**, and each card now carries a ⛔ do-not-dispatch note recording the evidence above, so no seat picks up work that does not exist. The maintainer has been told the premise moved and the label state is theirs to confirm or revert.

**The audit's other result is unaffected:** the remaining 11 `domain:cli` holds carry proper body-level `Restart-when:` / `Blocked-by:` lines and are legal as written.

Triage — first-touch grading, closing **completed** (concentrated round, triage seat, session `session_0138jAR5jeREBpm4dhVvbWY7`).

The surviving defect this card settled on (after the filer's own correction: restart conditions existed but lived in comments, invisible to the body-line unlock scan) **has been repaired on both cards** — verified this round: #8343 and #7616 each now open with a machine-readable body `Restart-when:` line (both bodies edited 2026-08-17T22:19Z), and both are back in `pm:on-hold`, which the correction's evidence supports (no dispatchable work exists on either: #8343 waits on a published EE image bundling the already-merged PR #8358; #7616 waits on a spec release carrying `resolvePermissionSetsForContext`). The remaining 11 `domain:cli` holds were audited legal by the filer.

Nothing left for this card to hold open: the format repair is done, the two holds are legal as written, the per-card maintainer disposition (「放行两张被藏的 Bug」 → premise moved → hold restored with proper exits) is recorded on this thread, and the *systemic* half — comment-level restart conditions being invisible to the unlock scan — is already tracked by the durable-fix card #8941 plus the triage seat's standing instruction ⑥ (comment-level `Blocked-by:`/`Restart-when:` sweep). Closing as completed; reopen is free if either hold is found mis-stated.
